```yaml
name: Release Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run schema validation
        run: npm run validate:schema

      - name: Compile TypeScript
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run precommit tests
        run: npm test

  create-release-pr:
    needs: build-and-test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Create release PR
        run: npx changeset publish --yes
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow will trigger on pushes to the `main` branch. It first builds and tests the project, ensuring all changesets are valid and the code compiles successfully. If the tests pass, it then creates a release PR using the `changeset publish` command, which updates the `package.json` version, syncs the schema version in `index.json`, generates CHANGELOG entries, and consumes the changeset files. The `GITHUB_TOKEN` environment variable is used to authenticate the PR creation.
